testCase.name: [local] S22 Accessibility of the search states: search typed, no-match message announced, All Residents

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P2 · extra (accessibility, performance, prototype detail) · ours: accessibility (announced no-match message).

Suggestion A2 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was S2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Status and errors are not announced: errors, 'no results', Ask AI answers and 'Listening…' are silent for screen readers; toggles expose no selected/pressed state

Tickets: TFA-94745 etc. · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S22 Accessibility of the search states: search typed, no-match message announced, All Residents

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane fixture, both contexts

When Run axe on /rounding and /snf with a search typed, with a no-match search, and on NH All Residents; check that the no-match message is announced

Then No serious/critical violations in any of these states. The no-match message is a status message (role=status or aria-live), so a screen reader announces it (WCAG 4.1.3). Clear search has an accessible name

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core serious/critical = 0 per state, plus a DOM check that the no-match paragraph sits in a role=status / aria-live region (axe does not test 4.1.3). Ticket snapshot and risks predict a Fail on the live-region check

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92581 ready for qa

When a search finds nothing, 'No patients match …' or 'No residents match …' is not announced, so a screen-reader user hears nothing; the same contrast and unnamed-button problems show in every search state.

Evidence: visual lane: 6 pass, 21 fail across 3 devices. The no-match paragraph is not in a role=status/aria-live region (WCAG 4.1.3), as the oracle predicted. Clear search is named correctly.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) (VISUAL (axe per search state plus a DOM check for role=status/aria-live)); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
